
```jsx
import { CxCardImage } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxCardImage from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/card/CxCardImage'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the base component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **component** | Component used for the root node. Either a string to use a HTML element or a component. | `string` \| `ComponentClass<any, any>` \| `FunctionComponent<any>` \| `undefined` | img |
| **orientation** | Optionally orientate the image to the top, bottom, or make it overlaid across the card. | `'top'` \| `'bottom'` \| `undefined` | - |
